messages:
Anya: Need lightweight asset pack for next-week webinar: 1 hero (1200x600), 3 social tiles (1200x1200), and a single-slide bench diagram showing latency vs cost. Accessible colors, alt-text sheet, and export-ready PDFs. Can we get drafts by Fri EOD?
Maya: Yep. Any copy or tone guidance? Minimal, data-led. Will keep headlines <6 words.
Tom: Figma base: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/launch-bench I created page "Apr-webinar-assets". Static assets + 1 micro-GIF (800x800) if time.
DesignBot: Page created. Export slices added (png/svg/pdf). Version v1. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/launch-bench?node-id=98%3A1
Anya: Legal note  include attribution for any 3rd-party benchmarks and label internal data as "Redwood internal benchmark, Apr 2026".
Legal: Will review copy + attribution Mon morning. If third-party logos appear we need clearance; otherwise text-only ok.
Maya: Accessibility checklist I'll follow: contrast >=4.5 for body, alt text one-line + two bullets, avoid red/green-only encodings. Will deliver alt-text csv.
Tom: Plan: hero + slide first, then tiles. I'll upload first static drafts to figma by Fri noon; GIF after if schedule allows.
Anya: Perfect. Keep logo lockup spacing consistent with brand guide. Ping if any blocker. :white_check_mark:
